mentions.name: Zen Notes
mentions.description: A minimal, distraction-free notes app built around ownership and longevity. Notes are stored locally in SQLite using standard Markdown to avoid vendor lock-in, with instant BM25 full-text search, flexible tag organization instead of folders, a Markdown formatting toolbar, custom Focus Modes, and offline read-only PWA support. It ships as a single binary with minimal dependencies (self-hosted Preact, Golang standard library) and can also run via Docker.
mentions.problem: Vendor lock-in and proprietary formats put long-term ownership of notes at risk, and flashy interfaces distract from focused thinking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Zen Notes - a minimal, distraction-free notes app that prioritizes ownership and longevity.
